collection.description: A parent learns that their child wants a different name or presentation.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (parent) learns that their child, (child), wants a different name or presentation.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) appreciates the reassurance but wants time alone.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (parent) helps with a chosen name or clothing color.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The family gradually grows comfortable with it.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (parent) makes occasional mistakes and corrects them gently.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) decides whom to tell and when.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) prefers to keep the news within the family for now.
